version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: NUM_AGG_SERVERS
  description: Number of aggregated servers
  type: integer
  value: 2

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 128
  domain:
  - 128

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 1
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:0.8.0

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

- name: benchmark
  type: srun
  container_image: python:3.12-slim
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (0.8.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==0.8.0 ai-dynamo==0.8.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8000;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: agg_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_AGG_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE=$(echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5557 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
          unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          ray start --head --port=6379
        else
          export RAY_worker_register_timeout_seconds=1200
          ray start --address ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:6379
        fi
        while true; do
          if ray status | grep "2.0 GPU"; then
            break
          else
            echo "Waiting for Ray cluster GPUs to be available in ray status..."
            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 2 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
        EXTRA_RAY_ARGS=""
        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}
      else
        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"
        sleep 3600
      fi
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 2
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: benchmark_aiperf
    operator:
      name: benchmark
      ntasks: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - pip install aiperf==0.3.0
    - export COLUMNS=200
    - 'aiperf profile --artifact-dir ${SFLOW_WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR}/aiperf_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY} --model Qwen3-8B-FP8 --tokenizer ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --endpoint-type chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --streaming --url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 --synthetic-input-tokens-mean 1024 --synthetic-input-tokens-stddev 0 --output-tokens-mean 1024 --output-tokens-stddev 0 --extra-inputs "max_tokens:1024" --extra-inputs "min_tokens:1024" --extra-inputs "ignore_eos:true" --extra-inputs "repetition_penalty:1.0" --extra-inputs "temperature: 0.0" --concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} --request-count $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) --warmup-request-count ${CONCURRENCY} --num-dataset-entries $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) --random-seed 100 -H ''Authorization: Bearer NOT USED'' -H ''Accept: text/event-stream'' --record-processors 8 --ui simple'
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - agg_server
    - frontend_server

          else

            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 1 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
        EXTRA_RAY_ARGS=""
        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --is-prefill-worker \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}
      else
        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"
        sleep 3600
      fi
    resources:
      gpus:

    depends_on:

          else

    - |

    resources:

    depends_on:

    probes:
      readiness:

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: NUM_CTX_SERVERS
  description: Number of context/prefill servers
  value: 1

- name: NUM_GEN_SERVERS
  description: Number of generation/decode servers
  value: 1

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 16
  domain:
  - 16

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 1
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

- name: PREFILL_CONFIG
  uri: file://prefill_config.yaml
  content: |
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_num_tokens: 4096
    max_seq_len: 1280
    tensor_parallel_size: 2
    moe_expert_parallel_size: 2
    enable_attention_dp: False
    pipeline_parallel_size: 1
    cuda_graph_config: null
    print_iter_log: true
    disable_overlap_scheduler: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8
    cache_transceiver_config:
      max_tokens_in_buffer: 4096
      backend: UCX

- name: DECODE_CONFIG
  uri: file://decode_config.yaml
  content: |
    tensor_parallel_size: 2
    moe_expert_parallel_size: 2
    enable_attention_dp: False
    pipeline_parallel_size: 1
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_num_tokens: 4096
    max_seq_len: 2304
    cuda_graph_config:
      enable_padding: true
      max_batch_size: 128
    print_iter_log: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8
    cache_transceiver_config:
      max_tokens_in_buffer: 4096
      backend: UCX
    stream_interval: 20

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/tensorrtllm-runtime:0.8.1.post2

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (1.3.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==1.3.0 ai-dynamo==1.3.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8000;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 2
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_CTX_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}

    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode prefill --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.PREFILL_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 2
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: decode_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 2
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_GEN_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel

    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode decode --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.DECODE_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:

    depends_on:

    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'

      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (0.8.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==0.8.0 ai-dynamo==0.8.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 2
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8000;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_CTX_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE=$(echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5557 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
          unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          ray start --head --port=6379
        else
          export RAY_worker_register_timeout_seconds=1200
          ray start --address ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:6379
        fi
        while true; do
          if ray status | grep "1.0 GPU"; then
            break
          else
            echo "Waiting for Ray cluster GPUs to be available in ray status..."
            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 1 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
        EXTRA_RAY_ARGS=""
        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --is-prefill-worker \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}
      else
        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"
        sleep 3600
      fi
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 1
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:

          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: decode_server
    operator:

          else

            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 2 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then

        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \

        --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}

        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"

        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: benchmark_infmax
    operator:

      extra_args:

    script:

        --base-url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 \

        --random-input-len 1024 \

        --num-prompts $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) \
        --max-concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} \
        --request-rate inf \
        --ignore-eos \
        --save-result \
        --num-warmups "$((2 * ${CONCURRENCY}))" \
        --percentile-metrics 'ttft,tpot,itl,e2el'  \
        --result-dir ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR} \
        --result-filename benchmark_serving_isl_1024_osl_1024_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY}.json
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - prefill_server
    - decode_server
    - frontend_server
    - load_image

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: NUM_AGG_SERVERS
  description: Number of aggregated servers
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 1
  domain:
  - 1
  - 3
  - 5

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 1
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

- name: AGG_CONFIG
  uri: file://agg_config.yaml
  content: |
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_num_tokens: 4096
    max_seq_len: 2304
    tensor_parallel_size: 4
    moe_expert_parallel_size: 4
    enable_attention_dp: False
    pipeline_parallel_size: 1
    cuda_graph_config:
      enable_padding: true
      max_batch_size: 128
    print_iter_log: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true

- name: nginx

- name: benchmark

  mpi: pmix

  name: dynamo_benchmark

        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor

    script:

    probes:

      done

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS

  type: integer
  value: 2

- name: NUM_CTX_SERVERS
  description: Number of context/prefill servers
  value: 4

- name: NUM_GEN_SERVERS
  description: Number of generation/decode servers
  value: 1

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 32
  domain:
  - 32

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 2
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

- name: PREFILL_CONFIG
  uri: file://prefill_config.yaml
  content: |
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_num_tokens: 4096
    max_seq_len: 1280
    tensor_parallel_size: 1
    moe_expert_parallel_size: 1
    enable_attention_dp: False
    pipeline_parallel_size: 1
    cuda_graph_config: null
    print_iter_log: true
    disable_overlap_scheduler: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8
    cache_transceiver_config:
      max_tokens_in_buffer: 4096
      backend: UCX

- name: DECODE_CONFIG
  uri: file://decode_config.yaml
  content: |
    tensor_parallel_size: 4
    moe_expert_parallel_size: 4
    enable_attention_dp: False
    pipeline_parallel_size: 1
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_num_tokens: 4096
    max_seq_len: 2304
    cuda_graph_config:
      enable_padding: true
      max_batch_size: 128
    print_iter_log: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8
    cache_transceiver_config:
      max_tokens_in_buffer: 4096
      backend: UCX
    stream_interval: 20

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/tensorrtllm-runtime:0.8.1.post2

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (1.3.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==1.3.0 ai-dynamo==1.3.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 2
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8180
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8180
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8180;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_CTX_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export TLLM_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode prefill --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.PREFILL_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 1
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: decode_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 4
      ntasks_per_node: 4
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_GEN_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export TLLM_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode decode --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.DECODE_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 4
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: benchmark_infmax
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      extra_args:
      - --container-remap-root
    script:
    - set -x
    - apt-get update
    - apt-get install -y curl
    - curl -L -o InferenceX.tar.gz https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/archive/89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc.tar.gz
    - tar xf InferenceX.tar.gz
    - mv InferenceX-89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc InferenceX
    - |
      python3 InferenceX/utils/bench_serving/benchmark_serving.py \
        --model Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tokenizer ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --backend openai-chat \
        --base-url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 \
        --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
        --dataset-name random \
        --seed 100 \
        --random-input-len 1024 \
        --random-output-len 1024 \
        --random-range-ratio 1.0 \
        --num-prompts $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) \
        --max-concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} \
        --request-rate inf \
        --ignore-eos \
        --save-result \
        --num-warmups "$((2 * ${CONCURRENCY}))" \
        --percentile-metrics 'ttft,tpot,itl,e2el'  \
        --result-dir ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR} \
        --result-filename benchmark_serving_isl_1024_osl_1024_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY}.json
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - prefill_server
    - decode_server
    - frontend_server
    - load_image

    probes:

        tcp_port:

  - name: etcd_server

    resources:

      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8180
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8180
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1

    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}

    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
          unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          ray start --head --port=6379
        else
          export RAY_worker_register_timeout_seconds=1200
          ray start --address ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:6379
        fi
        while true; do
          if ray status | grep "1.0 GPU"; then
            break
          else
            echo "Waiting for Ray cluster GPUs to be available in ray status..."
            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."

      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then

        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --is-prefill-worker \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}

        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"

      fi
    resources:

            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)

        interval: 30

          else

          fi
        done

    - |

    probes:

        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

    script:

    - |

        --base-url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 \

        --ignore-eos \

        --num-warmups "$((2 * ${CONCURRENCY}))" \
        --percentile-metrics 'ttft,tpot,itl,e2el'  \
        --result-dir ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR} \

    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:

      policy: sequential

    - decode_server
    - frontend_server

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: NUM_AGG_SERVERS
  description: Number of aggregated servers
  type: integer
  value: 2

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 128
  domain:
  - 128

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 1
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:0.8.0

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

- name: benchmark
  type: srun
  container_image: python:3.12-slim
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (0.8.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==0.8.0 ai-dynamo==0.8.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 1
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor

        count: 1
    script:

    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:

    replicas:

    script:

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 1

- name: NUM_CTX_SERVERS
  description: Number of context/prefill servers
  type: integer
  value: 2

- name: NUM_GEN_SERVERS
  description: Number of generation/decode servers
  type: integer
  value: 3

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 8
  domain:
  - 8

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 2
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:0.8.0

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (0.8.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==0.8.0 ai-dynamo==0.8.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 2
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8000;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_CTX_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE=$(echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5557 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
          unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          ray start --head --port=6379
        else
          export RAY_worker_register_timeout_seconds=1200
          ray start --address ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:6379
        fi
        while true; do
          if ray status | grep "1.0 GPU"; then
            break
          else
            echo "Waiting for Ray cluster GPUs to be available in ray status..."
            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 1 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
        EXTRA_RAY_ARGS=""
        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --is-prefill-worker \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}
      else
        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"
        sleep 3600
      fi
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 1
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: decode_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_GEN_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE=$(echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5557 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
          unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          ray start --head --port=6379
        else
          export RAY_worker_register_timeout_seconds=1200
          ray start --address ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:6379
        fi
        while true; do
          if ray status | grep "2.0 GPU"; then
            break
          else
            echo "Waiting for Ray cluster GPUs to be available in ray status..."
            sleep 5
          fi
        done
        echo "Ray cluster GPUs are now available."
      else
        echo "Do not need to setup ray cluster because worker only needs 2 GPUs, and GPUS_PER_NODE is 4"
      fi
    - |
      if [[ "${SLURM_NODEID}" == "0" ]]; then
        EXTRA_RAY_ARGS=""
        if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
          EXTRA_RAY_ARGS="--distributed-executor-backend ray"
        fi
        python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
        --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
        --data-parallel-size 1 \
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
        --no-enable-prefix-caching \
        --block-size 128 \
        --max-num-seqs 128 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 ${EXTRA_RAY_ARGS}
      else
        echo "This is a worker node, do not need to run vllm launch cmd, but remember to setup ray cluster and launch in the master node"
        sleep 3600
      fi
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 2
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: benchmark_infmax
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      extra_args:
      - --container-remap-root
    script:
    - set -x
    - apt-get update
    - apt-get install -y curl
    - curl -L -o InferenceX.tar.gz https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/archive/89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc.tar.gz
    - tar xf InferenceX.tar.gz
    - mv InferenceX-89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc InferenceX
    - |
      python3 InferenceX/utils/bench_serving/benchmark_serving.py \
        --model Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tokenizer ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --backend openai-chat \
        --base-url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 \
        --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
        --dataset-name random \
        --seed 100 \
        --random-input-len 1024 \
        --random-output-len 1024 \
        --random-range-ratio 1.0 \
        --num-prompts $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) \
        --max-concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} \
        --request-rate inf \
        --ignore-eos \
        --save-result \
        --num-warmups "$((2 * ${CONCURRENCY}))" \
        --percentile-metrics 'ttft,tpot,itl,e2el'  \
        --result-dir ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR} \
        --result-filename benchmark_serving_isl_1024_osl_1024_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY}.json
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - prefill_server
    - decode_server
    - frontend_server
    - load_image

      else
