    print_iter_log: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    kv_cache_config:
      enable_block_reuse: false
      free_gpu_memory_fraction: 0.9
      dtype: fp8
    cache_transceiver_config:
      max_tokens_in_buffer: 4096
      backend: UCX
    stream_interval: 20

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/tensorrtllm-runtime:0.8.1.post2

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (1.3.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==1.3.0 ai-dynamo==1.3.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 2
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8180
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8180
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8180;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: prefill_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_CTX_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export TLLM_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode prefill --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.PREFILL_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 1
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: decode_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 4
      ntasks_per_node: 4
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_GEN_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export TLLM_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_ENABLE_ALLTOALL_WITHOUT_ALLGATHER=1
    - export TRTLLM_MOE_USE_LOW_PRECISION_COMBINE=1
    - env | grep TLLM
    - env | grep UCX
    - unset UCX_TLS
    - trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --disaggregation-mode decode --extra-engine-args ${{ artifacts.DECODE_CONFIG.path }}
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 4
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20
      failure:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Traceback (most recent call last)
          match_count: 5
        interval: 30

  - name: benchmark_infmax
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 1
      extra_args:
      - --container-remap-root
    script:
    - set -x
    - apt-get update
    - apt-get install -y curl
    - curl -L -o InferenceX.tar.gz https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/archive/89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc.tar.gz
    - tar xf InferenceX.tar.gz
    - mv InferenceX-89ce6098ef2bc4576a735c43f39c7d972b091cfc InferenceX
    - |
      python3 InferenceX/utils/bench_serving/benchmark_serving.py \
        --model Qwen3-8B-FP8 \
        --tokenizer ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} \
        --backend openai-chat \
        --base-url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 \
        --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
        --dataset-name random \
        --seed 100 \
        --random-input-len 1024 \
        --random-output-len 1024 \
        --random-range-ratio 1.0 \
        --num-prompts $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) \
        --max-concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} \
        --request-rate inf \
        --ignore-eos \
        --save-result \
        --num-warmups "$((2 * ${CONCURRENCY}))" \
        --percentile-metrics 'ttft,tpot,itl,e2el'  \
        --result-dir ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR} \
        --result-filename benchmark_serving_isl_1024_osl_1024_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY}.json
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - prefill_server
    - decode_server
    - frontend_server
    - load_image

"""Composed-snapshot injection of CLI-enabled monitors (`_compose_files`)."""

import textwrap

import pytest
import yaml

from sflow.cli.compose import _compose_files


def _write(tmp_path, text):
    p = tmp_path / "wf.yaml"
    p.write_text(textwrap.dedent(text))
    return p


def _recipe(tmp_path):
    return _write(
        tmp_path,
        """
        version: "0.1"
        workflow:
          name: wf
          tasks:
            - name: warmup
              script: [echo a]
            - name: work
              depends_on: [warmup]
              script: [echo b]
        """,
    )


def test_compose_injects_workflow_and_task_monitor(tmp_path):
    out = _compose_files(
        [_recipe(tmp_path)],
        None,
        None,
        "info",
        enable_workflow_monitor=True,
        enable_task_monitors=["work"],
    )
    data = yaml.safe_load(out)
    # Workflow-level monitor present.
    assert data["workflow"]["monitor"] == {"report": {"enabled": True}}
    # Task-level monitor only on the named task.
    tasks = {t["name"]: t for t in data["workflow"]["tasks"]}
    assert tasks["work"]["monitor"] == {"report": {"enabled": True}}
    assert "monitor" not in tasks["warmup"]


def test_compose_without_flags_has_no_monitor(tmp_path):
    out = _compose_files([_recipe(tmp_path)], None, None, "info")
    data = yaml.safe_load(out)
    assert "monitor" not in data["workflow"]
    for t in data["workflow"]["tasks"]:
        assert "monitor" not in t


def test_compose_does_not_override_recipe_monitor(tmp_path):
    recipe = _write(
        tmp_path,
        """
        version: "0.1"
        workflow:
          name: wf
          monitor:
            scopes:
              gpu: {}
          tasks:
            - name: work
              script: [echo b]
              monitor:
                scopes:
                  cpu: {}
        """,
    )
    out = _compose_files(
        [recipe],
        None,
        None,
        "info",
        enable_workflow_monitor=True,
        enable_task_monitors=["work"],
    )
    data = yaml.safe_load(out)
    # Recipe-defined monitors are preserved (CLI is a no-op where one exists).
    assert data["workflow"]["monitor"] == {"scopes": {"gpu": {}}}
    work = data["workflow"]["tasks"][0]
    assert work["monitor"] == {"scopes": {"cpu": {}}}


def test_compose_unknown_task_raises(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unknown task"):
        _compose_files(
            [_recipe(tmp_path)],
            None,
            None,
            "info",
            enable_task_monitors=["ghost"],
        )

      \ own binding wins.\n_sflow_bound=0\nfor _a in \"$@\"; do\n  case \"${_a}\" in\n    --bind-to|--bind-to=*|--map-by|--map-by=*|--rankfile|--rankfile=*|-rf|--cpu-list|--cpu-list=*|--use-hwthread-cpus)\
      \ _sflow_bound=1; break ;;\n  esac\ndone\nif [ \"${_sflow_bound}\" = \"0\" ]; then\n  _sflow_ncpu=$(env\
      \ -u OMP_NUM_THREADS -u OMP_THREAD_LIMIT nproc 2>/dev/null || nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)\n  _sflow_nall=$(nproc\
      \ --all 2>/dev/null || echo \"${_sflow_ncpu}\")\n  [ \"${_sflow_ncpu}\" -gt \"${_sflow_nall}\" ]\
      \ 2>/dev/null && _sflow_ncpu=${_sflow_nall}\n  _sflow_smt=$(LC_ALL=C lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F:\
      \ '/^Thread\\(s\\) per core/ {gsub(/[^0-9]/, \"\", $2); print $2; exit}')\n  case \"${_sflow_smt}\"\
      \ in \"\"|*[!0-9]*) _sflow_smt=0 ;; esac\n  if [ \"${_sflow_smt}\" -lt 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n \
      \   _sflow_smt=$(awk -F, '{n=0; for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) { if ($i ~ /-/) { split($i, r, \"-\"); n +=\
      \ r[2] - r[1] + 1 } else { n++ } } print n; exit}' /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list\
      \ 2>/dev/null)\n    case \"${_sflow_smt}\" in \"\"|*[!0-9]*) _sflow_smt=1 ;; esac\n    [ \"${_sflow_smt}\"\
      \ -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null || _sflow_smt=1\n  fi\n  _sflow_cores=$(( _sflow_ncpu / _sflow_smt )); [ \"\
      ${_sflow_cores}\" -ge 1 ] || _sflow_cores=1\n  if [ \"${_sflow_cores}\" -lt 8 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n\
      \    echo \"sflow: pod cpuset has ${_sflow_cores} core(s) < 8 rank(s); skipping --bind-to core (would\
      \ abort mpirun)\" >&2\n  else\n    _sflow_pe=$(( _sflow_cores / 8 )); [ \"${_sflow_pe}\" -ge 1 ]\
      \ || _sflow_pe=1\n    [ \"${_sflow_pe}\" -gt 8 ] && _sflow_pe=8\n    echo \"sflow: binding 8 rank(s)\
      \ to ${_sflow_pe} core(s) each (${_sflow_ncpu} cpu(s) / ${_sflow_smt} thread(s) per core, cap 8)\"\
      \ >&2\n    _sflow_opts+=(--map-by ppr:8:node:PE=${_sflow_pe} --bind-to core)\n  fi\nfi\n# Forward\
      \ env to remote ranks (sshd gives them a bare env), deduped, from three\n# sources: the always-on\
      \ whole-name vars, the merged prefix set (scanned NOW so late\n# `export`s are captured), and every\
      \ var the recipe itself exported -- the diff of\n# the current exports against the pre-recipe snapshot\
      \ -- so a plain `export FOO=bar`\n# reaches workers without listing it in forward_env_prefixes.\n\
      _sflow_snap=\"${SFLOW_MPI_ENV_SNAPSHOT:-/tmp/sflow-mpi/env.snapshot}\"\n_sflow_names=\"$(\n  for\
      \ _v in PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH OMP_NUM_THREADS; do\n    eval \"[ -n \\\"\\${${_v}+x}\\\" ]\" && printf\
      \ '%s\\n' \"${_v}\"\n  done\n  env | grep -oE '^(NCCL_|UCX_|GLOO_|NVSHMEM_|OMPI_MCA_|SFLOW_)[A-Za-z0-9_]*'\n\
      \  [ -f \"${_sflow_snap}\" ] && comm -13 \"${_sflow_snap}\" <(compgen -e | sort -u)\n)\"\nfor _v\
      \ in $(printf '%s\\n' \"${_sflow_names}\" | sort -u | sed '/^$/d'); do\n  _sflow_opts+=(-x \"${_v}\"\
      )\ndone\n# Surface the fully-resolved launch -- the real mpirun + every sflow-injected opt\n# (hostfile,\
      \ SSH transport, CPU binding, env forwarding) + the recipe's own args -- so\n# the actual command\
      \ that ran is visible in the task log (the shim otherwise exec's\n# silently). Only the leader reaches\
      \ this line (workers idle in the role barrier above).\n# To STDERR: the task log captures both streams,\
      \ so it stays visible, but the workload's\n# stdout stays clean for result parsing / a tee'd rank\
      \ capture.\necho \"[sflow-mpi] launch: ${_sflow_real} ${_sflow_opts[*]} $*\" >&2\nexec \"${_sflow_real}\"\
      \ \"${_sflow_opts[@]}\" \"$@\"\n\nSFLOW_MPIRUN_WRAPPER_EOF\nchmod +x /tmp/sflow-mpi/bin/mpirun\n\
      export SFLOW_REAL_MPIRUN=\"${SFLOW_REAL_MPIRUN:-$(command -v mpirun 2>/dev/null || true)}\"\nexport\
      \ PATH=/tmp/sflow-mpi/bin:${PATH}\nexport SFLOW_MPI_NODE_INDEX=\"${SFLOW_TASK_NODE_INDEX:-0}\"\n\
      export SFLOW_MPI_NODE_IPS=\"${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS:-}\"\nexport SFLOW_MPI_N_NODES=$(printf\
      \ '%s' \"${SFLOW_MPI_NODE_IPS}\" | tr ',' '\\n' | grep -c '[^[:space:]]' || true)\nif [ \"${SFLOW_MPI_N_NODES:-0}\"\
      \ -gt 1 ]; then\n  echo \"[sflow-mpi] node ${SFLOW_MPI_NODE_INDEX}/${SFLOW_MPI_N_NODES}: preparing\
      \ SSH/MPI\"\n  if [ ! -x /usr/sbin/sshd ] && ! command -v sshd >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    echo \"\
      [sflow-mpi] installing openssh-server\"\n    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive\n    (apt-get\
      \ update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-server) || echo \"[sflow-mpi]\
      \ WARNING: could not install openssh-server\"\n  fi\n  mkdir -p /run/sshd /root/.ssh && chmod 755\
      \ /run/sshd && chmod 700 /root/.ssh\n  ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n  if [ -n \"${SFLOW_MPI_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_B64:-}\"\
      \ ]; then\n    printf %s \"${SFLOW_MPI_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY_B64}\" | base64 -d > /root/.ssh/id_rsa\n\
      \    printf %s \"${SFLOW_MPI_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY_B64:-}\" | base64 -d > /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub\n    cp\
      \ /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /root/.ssh/authorized_keys\n    chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys\
      \ /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub\n    printf 'Host *\\n  StrictHostKeyChecking no\\n  UserKnownHostsFile\
      \ /dev/null\\n' > /root/.ssh/config\n    chmod 600 /root/.ssh/config\n  else\n    echo \"[sflow-mpi]\
      \ FATAL: no injected SSH keypair; cannot bootstrap MPI over SSH\"\n    exit 1\n  fi\n  if [ \"${SFLOW_MPI_NODE_INDEX:-0}\"\
      \ = \"0\" ]; then\n    mkdir -p /tmp/sflow-mpi\n    printf '%s' \"${SFLOW_MPI_NODE_IPS}\" | tr ','\
      \ '\\n' | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' | awk '{print $1\" slots=8\"}' > /tmp/sflow-mpi/hostfile\n   \
      \ echo \"[sflow-mpi] hostfile:\"; cat /tmp/sflow-mpi/hostfile\n  fi\nfi\n# ===== end sflow k8s_mpi\
      \ bootstrap =====\n# --- sflow: snapshot exported env (pre-recipe) for mpirun -x auto-forward ---\n\

      \ 2>/dev/null || true\n# sflow: fail-fast\nset -e\nset -x\nexport TLLM_LOG_LEVEL=INFO\nexport TRTLLM_UCX_INTERFACE=${SFLOW_PRIMARY_IFACE:-eth0}\n\
      unset UCX_TLS\nexec mpirun -np 16 --allow-run-as-root trtllm-llmapi-launch python3 -m dynamo.trtllm\
      \ --model-path /models/Qwen3-0.6B --served-model-name Qwen3-0.6B --extra-engine-args /sflow-golden/sflow_output/trtllm_engine.yaml"

name: Deploy Docs to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - "docs/**"
      - "docs-site/**"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      deploy_pages: ${{ steps.deploy_eligibility.outputs.deploy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch docs version refs
        run: git fetch --tags origin "main:refs/remotes/origin/main" "develop:refs/remotes/origin/develop"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: docs-site
        run: npm install

      - name: Detect base URL from repo visibility
        id: baseurl
        run: |
          VISIBILITY="${{ github.event.repository.visibility }}"
          if [ "$VISIBILITY" = "public" ]; then
            echo "base_url=/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "base_url=/" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Build Docusaurus site
        working-directory: docs-site
        env:
          DOCS_BASE_URL: ${{ steps.baseurl.outputs.base_url }}
        run: |
          npm run prepare:versions
          npm run build:site

      - name: Detect deploy eligibility
        id: deploy_eligibility
        env:
          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CURRENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          deploy=false

          if [ "$REF_NAME" = "main" ]; then
            deploy=true
          elif [ "$REF_NAME" = "develop" ] && [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            base="$BEFORE_SHA"
            if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
              base="HEAD^"
            fi

            changed_files="$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$CURRENT_SHA")"
            has_changes=false
            only_user_docs=true
            while IFS= read -r changed_file; do
              [ -z "$changed_file" ] && continue
              has_changes=true
              case "$changed_file" in
                docs/user/*) ;;
                *) only_user_docs=false ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$changed_files"

            if [ "$has_changes" = true ] && [ "$only_user_docs" = true ]; then
              deploy=true
            fi
          fi

          echo "deploy=$deploy" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: steps.deploy_eligibility.outputs.deploy == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: docs-site/build

  deploy:
    if: needs.build.outputs.deploy_pages == 'true'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: pip install uv
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv pip install --system -e ".[dev]"
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pytest tests/unit/ --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml

version: '0.1'

variables:

- name: NUM_FRONTENDS
  description: Number of frontend instances (1 = direct on node 0, >1 = nginx load-balanced)
  type: integer
  value: 2

- name: NUM_AGG_SERVERS
  description: Number of aggregated servers
  type: integer
  value: 8

- name: CONCURRENCY
  description: Concurrency
  value: 10
  domain:
  - 10

backends:

- name: slurm_cluster
  type: slurm
  default: true
  time: 120
  nodes: 2
  partition: your_slurm_partition
  account: your_slurm_account
  gpus_per_node: 4

artifacts:

- name: LOCAL_MODEL_PATH
  uri: fs:///your/path/to/model

operators:

- name: dynamo
  type: srun
  container_name: dynamo_image
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix
  extra_args:
  - --container-image=nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/sglang-runtime:1.3.0

- name: nginx
  type: srun
  container_image: nginx:latest
  container_writable: true

- name: benchmark
  type: srun
  container_image: python:3.12-slim
  container_writable: true
  mpi: pmix

workflow:
  name: dynamo_benchmark
  timeout: 115m
  variables:
  - name: HEAD_NODE_IP
    description: Head node IP (resolved after allocation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}
  - name: ETCD_ENDPOINTS
    description: ETCD endpoints
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:2379
  - name: NATS_SERVER
    description: NATS server URL
    value: nats://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:4222
  - name: ALL_NODE_IPS
    description: Comma-separated IPs of all allocated nodes (for nginx config generation)
    value: ${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes | map(attribute='ip_address') | join(',') }}
  tasks:

  - name: load_image
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - echo "Image Loaded"
    - sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Image Loaded
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2

  - name: install_dependency
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks: 2
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - |
      echo "Checking for dynamo, nats-server, and etcd..."

      # Install dynamo if missing (check for the base dynamo.frontend module which all backends use)
      if ! python3 -c "import dynamo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "dynamo not found, installing ai-dynamo packages (1.3.0)..."
        pip install --break-system-packages --quiet ai-dynamo-runtime==1.3.0 ai-dynamo==1.3.0
      else
        echo "dynamo already installed."
      fi

      # Install nats-server if missing
      if ! command -v nats-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading NATS (v2.10.28) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        NATS_DEB="nats-server-v2.10.28-$ARCH_SHORT.deb"
        NATS_URL="https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/releases/download/v2.10.28/${NATS_DEB}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$NATS_URL" -O "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
        dpkg-deb -x "configs/${NATS_DEB}" "$TMP_DIR"
        if [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/local/bin/nats-server" configs/
        elif [ -f "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" ]; then
          cp "$TMP_DIR/usr/bin/nats-server" configs/
        else
          echo "Could not find nats-server binary in .deb package"; exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x configs/nats-server
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR" "configs/${NATS_DEB}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "nats-server installed."
      else
        echo "nats-server already installed."
      fi

      # Install etcd if missing
      if ! command -v etcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkdir -p configs
        ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        case "$ARCH" in
          x86_64)  ARCH_SHORT="amd64" ;;
          aarch64) ARCH_SHORT="arm64" ;;
          *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "Downloading ETCD (v3.5.21) for $ARCH_SHORT..."
        ETCD_TAR="etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT.tar.gz"
        ETCD_URL="https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v3.5.21/${ETCD_TAR}"
        wget -q --tries=3 --waitretry=5 "$ETCD_URL" -O "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        tar -xzf "configs/${ETCD_TAR}" --strip-components=1 -C configs \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcd \
          etcd-v3.5.21-linux-$ARCH_SHORT/etcdctl
        chmod +x configs/etcd configs/etcdctl
        rm "configs/${ETCD_TAR}"
        export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
        echo "etcd installed."
      else
        echo "etcd already installed."
      fi

      echo "All dependencies checked."
      sleep 3600
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: All dependencies checked.
          match_count: 2
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: gpu_monitor
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 2
    script:
    - echo "Starting gpu monitor"
    - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,power.draw,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -lms 2000 | while IFS= read -r input || [ -n "$input" ] ; do timestamp=$(date +%s%3N); printf "%s.%s,%s\n" "${timestamp:0:10}" "${timestamp:10:3}" "${input}"; done >> ${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/gpu_monitor_node_${SLURM_NODEID}_${SLURMD_NODENAME}.log
    probes:
      readiness:
        log_watch:
          match_pattern: Starting gpu monitor
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image

  - name: nats_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - nats-server -js
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 4222
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: etcd_server
    operator: dynamo
    script:
    - export PATH="$PWD/configs:$PATH"
    - etcd --listen-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --advertise-client-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2379" --listen-peer-urls "http://0.0.0.0:2380" --initial-advertise-peer-urls "http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --initial-cluster "default=http://${HEAD_NODE_IP}:2380" --data-dir /tmp/etcd
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 2379
        timeout: 300
        interval: 2
    depends_on:
    - load_image
    - install_dependency

  - name: frontend_server
    operator: dynamo
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_FRONTENDS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8180
    resources:
      nodes:
        count: 1
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8180
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - nats_server
    - etcd_server

  - name: nginx_server
    operator: nginx
    script:
    - |
      if [ "${NUM_FRONTENDS}" -le 1 ]; then
        echo "Single frontend mode (NUM_FRONTENDS=${NUM_FRONTENDS}), nginx not needed."
        echo "Frontend is directly serving on port 8000 on this node."
        exit 0
      fi

      NGINX_CONF=${SFLOW_TASK_OUTPUT_DIR}/nginx.conf
      cat > $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_HEADER'
      worker_processes auto;
      events {
          worker_connections 65535;
          multi_accept on;
          use epoll;
      }
      http {
          access_log off;
          upstream backend_servers {
      CONF_HEADER

      # Build upstream entries from frontend node IPs.
      # Frontend replicas are assigned to nodes 0..NUM_FRONTENDS-1 via count=1.
      IFS=',' read -ra NODE_ARRAY <<< "${ALL_NODE_IPS}"
      for i in $(seq 0 $((NUM_FRONTENDS - 1))); do
          echo "        server ${NODE_ARRAY[$i]}:8180;" >> $NGINX_CONF
      done

      cat >> $NGINX_CONF << 'CONF_FOOTER'
          }
          server {
              listen 8000;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
                  proxy_buffering off;
                  proxy_read_timeout 24h;
                  proxy_send_timeout 24h;
              }
          }
      }
      CONF_FOOTER

      echo "Generated nginx.conf:"
      cat $NGINX_CONF
      /usr/sbin/nginx -c $NGINX_CONF -g 'daemon off;'
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    probes:
      readiness:
        tcp_port:
          port: 8000
        timeout: 300
        interval: 5
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server

  - name: agg_server
    operator:
      name: dynamo
      ntasks_per_node: 1
    replicas:
      count: ${{ variables.NUM_AGG_SERVERS }}
      policy: parallel
    script:
    - set -x
    - echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}
    - export FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE=$(echo ${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - export NODE_RANK=${SLURM_NODEID}
    - export FIRST_NODE_IP=$(echo ${SFLOW_TASK_ASSIGNED_NODE_IPS} | cut -d',' -f1)
    - |
      if [ "1" -gt 1 ]; then
        export MULTI_NODE_EXTRA_ARGS="--dist-init-addr ${FIRST_NODE_IP}:29500 --nnodes 1 --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}"
      else
        export MULTI_NODE_EXTRA_ARGS=""
      fi
    - export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=$((5557 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - export DYN_SYSTEM_PORT=$((8082 + ${FIRST_CUDA_DEVICE}))
    - python3 -m dynamo.sglang --model-path ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --served-model-name Qwen3-8B-FP8 --tensor-parallel-size  1 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --data-parallel-size 1 --expert-parallel-size 1 --moe-dense-tp-size 1 --max-running-requests 128 --max-prefill-tokens 4096  --trust-remote-code --skip-tokenizer-init --cuda-graph-max-bs 128 ${MULTI_NODE_EXTRA_ARGS} --host 0.0.0.0
    resources:
      gpus:
        count: 1
    depends_on:
    - frontend_server
    probes:
      readiness:
        http_post:
          url: http://${{ backends.slurm_cluster.nodes[0].ip_address }}:8000/v1/chat/completions
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: '{"model": "Qwen3-8B-FP8", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 1}'
        timeout: 1200
        interval: 20

  - name: benchmark_aiperf
    operator:
      name: benchmark
      ntasks: 1
    script:
    - set -x
    - pip install aiperf==0.3.0
    - export COLUMNS=200
    - 'aiperf profile --artifact-dir ${SFLOW_WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR}/aiperf_concurrency_${CONCURRENCY} --model Qwen3-8B-FP8 --tokenizer ${{ artifacts.LOCAL_MODEL_PATH.path }} --endpoint-type chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --streaming --url http://${{ variables.HEAD_NODE_IP }}:8000 --synthetic-input-tokens-mean 1024 --synthetic-input-tokens-stddev 0 --output-tokens-mean 1024 --output-tokens-stddev 0 --extra-inputs "max_tokens:1024" --extra-inputs "min_tokens:1024" --extra-inputs "ignore_eos:true" --extra-inputs "repetition_penalty:1.0" --extra-inputs "temperature: 0.0" --concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} --request-count $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) --warmup-request-count ${CONCURRENCY} --num-dataset-entries $((8*${CONCURRENCY})) --random-seed 100 -H ''Authorization: Bearer NOT USED'' -H ''Accept: text/event-stream'' --record-processors 8 --ui simple'
    - echo "Benchmarking finished"
    resources:
      nodes:
        indices:
        - 0
    replicas:
      variables:
      - CONCURRENCY
      policy: sequential
    depends_on:
    - agg_server
    - frontend_server
